files.dialog.css: .master-dialog{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(780px,calc(100% - 32px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;border:1px solid #bac2cf;border-radius:12px;padding:24px;color:#242b36;font-family:system-ui}.master-dialog::backdrop{background:#15203688}.master-dialog h1{font-size:22px;margin-top:0}.master-dialog-content{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:24px}.master-dialog fieldset{min-width:0;margin:0;padding:8px;border:1px solid #ccd1db}.master-dialog label{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:10px;align-items:baseline;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.master-dialog section{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.master-dialog dt{font-weight:600}.master-dialog dd{margin:4px 0 16px}.master-dialog footer{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}.master-dialog button{font:inherit;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid #9da9bc;border-radius:6px}.master-dialog :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #4168c8;outline-offset:2px}@media(max-width:560px){.master-dialog-content{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.master-dialog{padding:16px}}
